title: ci(live-e2e): boot the workspace backend and run the live lane as the required Live E2E UI job
body:
Fixes #27154
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** live e2e 四条 spec 改为用本树工作区自建的 `@objectstack/cli` 启动 `examples/app-showcase` 后端（HEAD console 对 HEAD backend），已发布版本钉退役；`ci.yml` 新增 `Live E2E UI` job，并登记进 `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS`。
- **为什么改：** 按已发布版本钉后端，每次发版都得同步抬钉，否则 `ui/` 的 PR 全红（#25914 实测 18.1.0 下 0/5）；裁决 6464191239 字母 D 第 2 步要求改为工作区后端后再升为 required。
- **风险与回滚：** Tier H（`.github/workflows/ci.yml`、`AGENTS.md`）；回滚 = 还原本 PR（job、注册行、两处名单文字、两个脚本）。新 job 超时上限 40 分钟由一次本地冷跑推得，首批 CI 数据后需复核。
- **先看：** `ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`（prepare 只校验构建产物、不再拉包）→ `ci.yml` 的 `live-e2e-ui` job → `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` 新注册行。
- **两分钟验证：** 打开本 PR 的 checks，`Live E2E UI` 应为绿色，日志 “Run the live e2e specs” 一步显示 `5 passed`。
- **需要你做的：** 合并后在 `main` 的 ruleset 里把 `Live E2E UI` 勾为 required（席位做不了）。

## What changes

- `ui/e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh` boots the WORKSPACE backend: this tree's built `@objectstack/cli` (through `examples/app-showcase/node_modules/.bin/objectstack`) runs `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p $LIVE_BACKEND_PORT` from the checked-out showcase. Same default port (4010), same seeded sign-in readiness poll (300 s), same pid file, so `stop-backend.sh` is unchanged and its PID contract holds. `prepare` no longer resolves a release tag, sparse-checks-out a release or `npm install`s published tarballs; it checks the build prerequisite (the app's config, the installed CLI bin, `packages/cli/dist/index.js`) and refuses by name with the build command when one is missing. The vitest override and the stamp retire with the install.
- `ui/e2e/live/ci/backend.env` declares `LIVE_BACKEND_APP=examples/app-showcase` and no published pin; its comment records why `OBJECTSTACK_VERSION` retired.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` adds `live-e2e-ui` / `Live E2E UI`: install, build the CLI + showcase closure and the seven packages the Console builds against, `vite build` the Console with `VITE_BASE_PATH=/`, provision Chromium through `ensure-chromium-ready.sh`, boot the backend, serve `vite preview` on :5190 with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4010`, and run `pnpm --dir ui run test:e2e:live:ci --retries 0`. Triggers: the workflow's existing `pull_request` and `merge_group` (plus push/schedule, as every job in the file). `if:` is Build & E2E UI's condition verbatim (`ui_tree`, `ui || ui_consumers`, with `!cancelled()`). No `continue-on-error`, no retry wrapper, no spec edited or skipped. Caches are restore-only (pnpm store, Build Core's turbo seed, the Playwright browsers Build & E2E UI saves).
- `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs`: a `REQUIRED_CONTEXTS` row for `ci.yml:live-e2e-ui → 'Live E2E UI'`, and the name added to the two `statesTheSet` instruction surfaces' `mustName`; `AGENTS.md` (nine → ten contexts) and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/platform-readings.md` (九个 → 十个) name it.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/ensure-chromium-ready.test.ts` reads the new job as a second Chromium provisioner (its comment said `live-e2e.yml` "comes back here with that port"); `helpers/root-ci.ts` exports the job id as `UI_LIVE_E2E_JOB`, outside `UI_JOBS`.
- `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md` (advisory checks ride through) now counts ten required contexts, and the `ci.yml` `filter` job comment counts five `* UI` jobs (Type Check UI, Test UI, Lint UI, Build & E2E UI and Live E2E UI).

## Tests

Measured before wiring, on the workspace boot, at commit `7a48258d` (the re-shaped scripts; base `2f96d874`). Setup: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; turbo build of the CLI + showcase closure and the seven Console packages (65/65 tasks, 384 s cold under the shared-box lock); `VITE_BASE_PATH=/ vite build` of `ui/apps/console` (119 s); `start-backend.sh` exit 0, ready in 19 s (`@objectstack/cli 18.2.0` workspace); `vite preview --port 5190` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:4010`; `LIVE_API_URL=http://localhost:4010`, `LIVE_APP_URL=http://localhost:5190`; one backend for all five runs, as one CI job boots once.

| Run | Exit | Wall (s) | action-modal | master-detail: populated parent | master-detail: task line | saved-view-filter | screen-flow |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 26 | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| 2 | 0 | 23 | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| 3 | 0 | 22 | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| 4 | 0 | 23 | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |
| 5 | 0 | 21 | pass | pass | pass | pass | pass |

5/5 runs green, 5/5 tests per run; Playwright's own totals 24.1 s / 20.5 s / 20.7 s / 21.2 s / 19.9 s. Wall times are shared-box seconds. Teardown: `stop-backend.sh` stopped the recorded pid; the preview processes I started were stopped by pid.

Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `191e9d5e`, after merging `origin/main`): 87 commands, each exit captured before any pipe. 85 exit 0, including `pnpm check:required-contexts` (lists `ci.yml:live-e2e-ui → 'Live E2E UI'`), `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:stall-guard-budget`, `check:pm-expected-skips`, `check:aggregator-roster`, `check:bash32-floor`, `check:ci-filter-parity`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, and `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (175 files passed, 2 skipped; 5020 tests passed). Two did not measure the diff: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: no full `pnpm build` here) and `check:dts-closure` exit 1, which named only `ui/apps/console/plugin.d.ts`, missing from the `dist/` my bare `vite build` left behind; with that ignored directory removed it exits 0 (233/233 declaration files present). `--ran` with exit codes: 87 derived, 86 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (the exit 3). No package changes, so no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

On head `3f0b396f` (the text patch round): `CI` pull_request run 40678137074; `Live E2E UI` (job 122782123641) concluded success in 87 s of job wall time (Console build 11 s, backend boot 10 s, specs 18 s).

## Acceptance notes

- **The one step left is the maintainer's:** add `Live E2E UI` to the `main` ruleset's required status checks, in the same sitting as the merge (#9325 two-step). Until then `--verify-required-set` reports the row in direction A (pinned, not required), report-only.
- Ceiling `timeout-minutes: 40` is derived from one cold local run (≈730 s ⇒ max(36.5, 27.2) ⇒ 40, the rule above Lint UI), since the job has no CI population yet; the derivation sits beside the job and asks to be re-derived from the first population. Follow-up: #27228 (re-derive from at least 20 CI runs and pin it in `turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts`).
- The gate is Build & E2E UI's, as the card asks: a PR that changes only backend packages outside `ui/` and the seven `ui_consumers` packages (for example `packages/runtime`) skips this job, so a backend regression that breaks the live specs surfaces on the next `ui` PR or on `main`'s push run. Recorded, not widened.
- Not edited (claim: no spec edited): the header of `ui/e2e/live/saved-view-filter.spec.ts` still describes the retired `OBJECTSTACK_VERSION` pin. Follow-up: #27228.
- `vite preview` runs in the background for the rest of the job and is reaped by the runner at job end; the backend is stopped by `stop-backend.sh` under `if: always()`.

## Verification

Read this PR's `Live E2E UI` check: steps "Boot the workspace backend" (ends `ready: seeded sign-in answered on :4010`) and "Run the live e2e specs" (ends `5 passed`).
